headline: Core business matrix resilient; Enzene yet to pick up pace

highlights: Consolidation of Occlutech has boosted its revenue growth by ~3% and dragged EBITDA margins by ~80bps.
India business growth of 9.5% was supported by a ~12% rise in branded generics, though trade generics grew at a slower pace.
Management expects a stronger H2FY27 and guides for 11% growth in FY27 (9.8% in H1FY27) in India.
The pick-up in CDMO is short of management’s expectation; also, Alkem may have to refile denosumab biosimilar in US.

Management targets to sustain the growth momentum in the other international markets for the next 1.5 years.
The stock trades at valuations of 27.9x FY27E and 24x FY28E earnings and EV/EBITDA multiples of 17.7x FY27E and 15.3x FY28E.
watch: Management, though, remains firm on the outlook for Enzene (CDMO) and medtech business.
